content: गुरु {%a.%} (-रु, -र्वी|{%f.%}) [ग कु उच्च <ls>Uṇ. 1. 24.</ls>] (<ab>compar.</ab> गरीयस्; <ab>superl.</ab> गरिष्ठ) .²1 Heavy, weighty (<ab>opp.</ab> लघु); (<ab>fig.</ab> also); तेन धृर्जगतो गुर्वी सचिवेषु निचिक्षिपे <ls>R. 1. 34</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 35</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 102</ls>; विमुच्य वासांसि गुरूणि साम्प्रतम् <ls>Ṛs. 1. 7</ls>. .²2 Great, large, long, extended. .²3 Long (in duration or length); आरम्भगुर्वी <ls>Bh. 2. 60</ls>; गुरुषु दिवसेष्वेषु गच्छत्सु <ls>Me. 85</ls>. .²4 Important, momentous, great; विभवगुरुभिः कृत्यैः <ls>Ś. 4. 19</ls>; स्वार्थात्सतां गुरुतरा प्रणयिक्रियैव <ls>V. 4. 31</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 13</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 7</ls>; <ls>R. 14. 35</ls>. .²5 Arduous, difficult (to bear); कान्ताविरहगुरुणा शापेन <ls>Me. 1</ls>. .²6 Great, excessive, violent, intense; गुरुः प्रहर्षः प्रबभूव नात्मनि <ls>R. 3. 17</ls>; गुर्वपि विरहदुःखम् <ls>Ś. 4. 16</ls>; <ls>Bg. 6. 22</ls>. .²7 Venerable, respectable. .²8 Heavy, hard of digestion (as food). .²9 Best, excellent. .²10 Dear, beloved. .²11 Haughty, proud (as a speech). .²12 (In prosody) Long, as a syllable, either in itself, or being short, followed by a conjunct consonant <ab>&c.</ab>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} ई in ईड् or त in तस्कर (It is usually represented by ग in works on prosody; मात्तौ गौ चेच्छालिनी वेदलोकैः <ab>&c.</ab>). .²13 Irresistible, unassailable; जागर्ति दंशाय … गुरुर्भुजङ्गी <ls>Māl. 6. 1</ls>. .²14 Mighty; powerful. .²15 Valuable, highly prized; पूर्वं पूर्वं गुरु ज्ञेयम् <ls>Y. 2. 30</ls>. .²16 Grievous; <ls>Me. 85</ls>. .{@-रुः@} .²1 .³({%a%}) A father; न केवलं तद्गुरुरेकपार्थिवः क्षितावभूदेकधनुर्धरोऽपि सः <ls>R. 3. 31</ls>, <ls n="R. 3.">48</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 1</ls>, <ls n="R.">8. 29</ls>. .³({%b%}) Fore-father, ancestor; त्वां मैत्रावरुणोऽभिनन्दतु गुरुर्यस्ते गुरूणामपि <ls>U. 5. 27</ls>. .³({%c%}) Father-in-law; त्वं हि मे गुरुः (तद्धर्मतः स्नुषा तेऽहम्) <ls>Rām. 7. 26. 28-29</ls>. .²2 Any venerable or respectable person, an elderly personage or relative, the elders (<ab>pl.</ab>) शुश्रूषस्व गुरून् <ls>Ś. 4. 18</ls>; <ls>Bg. 2. 5</ls>; <ls>Bv. 2. 7</ls>, <ls n="Bv. 2.">18</ls>, <ls n="Bv. 2.">19</ls>, <ls n="Bv. 2.">49</ls>; आज्ञा गुरूणां ह्यविचारणीया <ls>R. 14. 46</ls>. .²3 A teacher, preceptor; गुरुशिष्यौ. .²4 Particularly, a religious teacher, spiritual preceptor; तौ गुरुर्गुरुपत्नी च प्रीत्या प्रतिननन्दतुः <ls>R. 1. 57</ls>; (technically a {%Guru%} is one who performs the purificatory ceremonies over a boy and instructs him in the Vedas; स गुरुर्यः क्रियाः कृत्वा वेदमस्मै प्रयच्छति <ls>Y. 1. 34</ls>). .²5 A lord, head, superintendent, ruler; सर्वे गुरुहिते स्थिताः <ls>Rām. 4. 40. 6</ls>; वर्णाश्रमाणां गुरवे स वर्णी <ls>R. 5. 19</ls> the head of the castes or orders; गुरुर्नृपाणां गुरवे निवेद्य <ls n="R.">2. 68</ls>. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods; गुरुं नेत्रसहस्रेण चोदयामास वासवः <ls>Ku. 2. 29</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 230</ls>. .²7 The planet Jupiter; गुरुकाव्यानुगां बिभ्रच्चान्द्रीमभिनभः श्रियम् <ls>Śi. 2. 2</ls>. .²8 The propounder of a new doctrine. .²9 The lunar asterism called पुष्य. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of Droṇa, teacher of the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas. .²11 <ab>N.</ab> of Prabhākara, the leader of a school of the Mīmāṃsakas (called after him Prābhākara). .²12 The supreme spirit.
